title: Fluoroscopic-Guided Micropuncture Technique for Common Femoral Artery Access
brief_summary: The main objective of this proposed study is to examine if oblique projection (20- degrees right anterior oblique (RAO) for right femoral artery access or 20-degree left anterior oblique (LAO) for left femoral artery access) is superior to anterior projection (AP) for femoral artery access in zone 2-4 and thereby resulting in lower risk of access related complications.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are undergoing cardiac catheterization or PCI

Exclusion Criteria:

* Peripheral vascular disease
* Renal failure, Creatinine \>2.5 mg/dL
* Hemodynamic instability, acute myocardial infarction
* Heart failure with EF\<25%
